meta.title: Extending the RFP beyond the RFQ's end is refused with 712

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.”, and never with a server error.
